title: Encrypted DNS Provisioning RFC 9464 Wire Codec Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, DNS package build, full solution test, and diff hygiene for the RFC 9464 wire-codec surface.
scope: This verification covers ENCDNS_IP* attribute field order, length-field value, RFC 9460 SvcParam wire key/length/value encoding, reserved-bit-tolerant decoding, AliasMode zero rejection, CFG_REPLY/CFG_SET zero-address rejection, forbidden hint service parameters by numeric key, ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO request field order, reply/set digest field order, registered hash algorithm identifiers, digest ADN scoping for multiple ADNs, zero-length CFG_ACK data, and SHA2-256 DER SPKI digest computation.
preconditions: The RFC 9464 specification exists as canonical JSON at `specs/requirements/quic/SPEC-QUIC-RFC9464.json`.
The RFC 9464 wire codec remains in `Incursa.Quic.Dns` and does not introduce IKEv2 session state.
expected_result: The focused provisioning tests pass, the DNS package builds, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9464 artifacts, generated triage reflects the wire-codec slice, diff hygiene passes, and the full solution test suite remains green.
status_summary: The RFC 9464 ENCDNS_IP* and ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO byte-level codec is trace-owned and verified. Full IKEv2 integration, resolver provisioning policy, and TLS certificate validation remain future work.
